question: Materialize the fixed multiscale proposal roster, final-layer template choice and layer-18 local scores for the fresh door-8 family before local-only ranking.

predecessor.single_change: Move the frozen D15 layer-18 local-only candidate chain to a pre-download, pre-RGB, pre-model new physical family; this intermediate retains fused ranking only to materialize the exact candidate score receipt.

proposal.selection: Union unchanged full-frame proposals with fixed 40-percent corner-tile proposals; no query truth access.

tiling.merge: Retain up to 16 full-frame and 8 per tile, remap to full-image coordinates, then score their SAM-masked descriptors together without NMS or truth filtering.

descriptor.feature: Final-layer foreground mean chooses the target reference only; normalized foreground patches from DINOv2 ViT-L/14 zero-based block 18 supply the query-directed local score.

appearance.score: For the final-layer-selected target reference, maximum cosine from each layer-18 query foreground patch to all reference foreground patches, averaged across query patches.
appearance.final_confirmation_ranking: Rank by layer-18 local appearance only; final-layer score, objectness, box and postprocess index are frozen tie breaks.

masker.contract: Apply unchanged native SAM2 to every retained proposal; final confirmation uses the mask belonging to local-only top one.

evaluation.truth_role: Provider truth enters only after frozen local-only ranking for opportunity and tight-mask-box IoU evaluation.

literature_motivation.use: Intermediate DINOv2 features preserve stronger spatial identity under appearance ambiguity.
Query-directed foreground patch matching and SAM refinement.

forbidden_after_freeze: change images, tiles, proposal settings, layer, local score, template choice, tie breaks, SAM or IoU gate
use sibling appearance or query truth to generate, filter, rank or prompt proposals
retry, replace a frame or add post-outcome rescue
claim_boundary: This intermediate only materializes the preregistered fresh-family candidate roster and scores. Final authority comes from the local-only wrapper. Neither artifact establishes open-set rejection, provider independence, raw-phone operation, named entrance ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, benefit, reliability or safety.
